rules.statement: An action by one co-owner can be maintained without joining all other co-owners if the dispute is between only a few of them and does not prejudice the rights of others.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion sections 17 and 22 of the Code are intended to do away with all technical objections on the score of non-joinder or mis-joinder of parties unless they are taken in due time and for good reason. If, however, it be found that the action cannot proceed for want of parties, section 18 enables the Court even mero motu to add such parties."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 17 and 22 of the Civil Procedure Code
